name: Holmusk NeuroBlu
one_liner: Real-world data platform for neuropsychiatry research with 46M+ patient records
short_description: NeuroBlu is Holmusk's real-world data (RWD) platform containing de-identified records from 46+ million behavioral health patients, used for research, drug development, and clinical decision support.
description: Holmusk NeuroBlu is the largest real-world evidence platform focused specifically on behavioral health, containing de-identified data from over 46 million patients across mental health and substance use treatment settings. The platform combines EHR data with patient-reported outcomes, using NLP and machine learning to extract insights from unstructured clinical notes. NeuroBlu supports pharmaceutical research, health economics outcomes research (HEOR), and clinical benchmarking. Holmusk also partners with organizations like Iris Telehealth to provide clinical decision support at the point of care.

faqs.a: NeuroBlu is Holmusk's real-world data platform containing de-identified records from 46+ million behavioral health patients. It's used for pharmaceutical research, health economics studies, and clinical benchmarking.

NeuroBlu contains de-identified EHR data, claims data, and patient-reported outcomes from behavioral health settings. NLP extracts structured information from clinical notes including diagnoses, medications, PHQ-9/GAD-7 scores, and treatment responses.

NeuroBlu is primarily used by pharmaceutical companies researching psychiatric medications, academic researchers, health economists conducting outcomes studies, and health plans analyzing behavioral health populations.

NeuroBlu is a research and analytics platform, not a clinical tool for individual practitioners. However, Holmusk partners with organizations like Iris Telehealth to bring insights to the point of care.
